theater: 伊松佐河東岸與卡爾索台地

battle.name: 伊孫佐戰役
battle.theater: 伊松佐河東岸與卡爾索台地
battle.brief: 一九一五年六月二十三日，義大利以十九個師約二十萬人向奧匈帝國發動第一次攻勢，主攻戈里齊亞橋頭堡，企圖指向的里雅斯特。步兵班與機槍連配發的菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914機槍在卡爾索台地的岩坡與塹壕前提供密集火力，但重砲掩護不足、射程受限，攻勢在戈里齊亞與蒙內羅山前被擋回。

kit.name: 菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914機
kit.history: 作為意大利軍第一款大量裝備的自動機槍，菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914在步兵班提供持續火力，並被裝甲車與固定據點廣泛使用。

countries: 交戰雙方是義大利王國與奧匈帝國。義大利方面由陸軍總參謀長路易吉·卡多爾納全權統帥，出兵第二、第三兩個集團軍，共十九個師，兵力約二十萬人；按官方編制，兩個集團軍下轄數個軍，每軍轄兩至三個步兵師，師內以營為作戰單位，營下設步兵連、機槍連與步兵砲兵連，另配工兵連與通信分隊，連以上設排與班。意軍在亞得里亞海一線部署皇家海軍第三、第六師的巡邏艦隊與魚雷艇，以水雷與封鎖切斷奧軍在特倫托與普拉托一帶的海上交通。奧匈帝國方面，由斯韋托扎爾·博羅埃維奇一級將軍率領第十五軍團及所屬部隊，防守伊松佐河東岸全線，兵力約十萬人、十三個師，配置於巴因西扎高地、卡爾索台地以及托爾明諾、戈里齊亞兩處橋頭堡。奧軍除步兵師外，另有帝國皇家地方守備隊分守各段要塞與堡壘，並有工兵、測量與通信技術部隊駐紮各陣地。義大利在此役中名義上站在協約國一方，但實際投入的只有陸軍與海軍主力，境內其他方向的部隊仍被用來對德與對奧維持第二道防線，可用於一次攻勢的兵力因此有限。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Kingdom of Italy and Austria-Hungary. On the Italian side, the supreme commander of the army, General Luigi Cadorna, directed everything, committing the 2nd and 3rd Armies, nineteen divisions in all, with a strength of roughly two hundred thousand men. According to the official tables of organisation, each army contained a number of corps, each corps two or three infantry divisions, and inside a division the battalion was the unit of manoeuvre: a battalion comprised three infantry companies, a machine gun company and an infantry artillery company, together with an engineer company and a signals detachment, while below the company stood platoons and sections. On the Adriatic the Italians deployed the patrols and torpedo boats of the 3rd and 6th Divisions of the Royal Navy, using mines and a blockade to cut the sea communications of the Austro-Hungarian forces around Trieste and Pola. On the Austro-Hungarian side, Field Marshal Svetozar Boroević led the XV Army Corps and its attached formations, holding the entire eastern bank of the Isonzo with about one hundred thousand men in thirteen divisions, deployed on the Barcis plateau, on the Carso highlands and in the two bridgeheads at Tolmino and Gorizia. Besides the infantry divisions, the Imperial and Royal Landwehr manned the blockhouses and sector works, and engineer, survey and signal-technical units were quartered in the individual positions. Nominally Italy fought on the side of the Entente, but in this battle it committed only the bulk of its army and navy; troops on every other front were still being used to hold a second line against Germany and Austria, which left the force available for a single offensive strictly limited.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩端的指揮部。義大利總參謀長路易吉·卡多爾納是整場攻勢的設計者，他主張以連續攻勢消耗奧匈，用密集砲火配合步兵與機槍的正面強攻，逐次奪取卡爾索台地與戈里齊亞；攻勢發起前他致國王維多利奧三世的電文表明「非勝即死」的決心，並在戰後以十二次伊松佐河戰役反覆實踐同一套方針。第二集團軍由亞歷山德羅·皮魯阿齊一級將軍統率，負責正面壓制戈里齊亞橋頭堡；第三集團軍由恩里科·蒙貝利一級將軍統率，負責蒙內羅山與上游的攻擊，兩人指揮權責的具體劃分在義大利官方戰史與專著之間略有出入。奧軍方面，斯韋托扎爾·博羅埃維奇是東線實際的守備主腦，他把有限兵力集中於卡爾索與巴因西扎的既設陣地，寧可承受局部讓地也不讓義軍切斷戈里齊亞至維也納的鐵路，並以巢式砲兵與工兵加固塹壕。帝國總參謀長魯道夫·馮·瓦爾德施泰滕把主攻方向放在塞爾維亞戰線，故伊松佐正面只得到相對有限的增援，奧皇弗朗茨·約瑟夫一世則認可了集團軍採取的防禦姿態。義大利海軍第三、第六師在海上執行對的里雅斯特的封鎖，兩軍工兵在前沿晝夜施工；卡面那門機槍出自陸軍武器委員會與菲亞特工程人員的共同設計，同期菲亞特自研的裝甲車也在卡爾索一帶試驗，車上同樣架設雷維利機槍。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sat at the two headquarters. Luigi Cadorna, General Chief of Staff of the Italian army, designed the offensive itself: he wanted to wear Austria-Hungary down by a series of continuous attacks, each combining massed artillery with infantry and machine guns in a frontal rush, and he took the same line again and again through the twelve battles of the Isonzo. Before the attack went in he telegraphed King Victor Emmanuel III to make his resolve unambiguous, that the army would win or perish, and he repeated the same doctrine after the failure. The 2nd Army, under General Alessandro Pirouazzi, was to pin and then crush the Gorizia bridgehead; the 3rd Army, under General Enrico Mombelli, was given the attack on Mount Monte Nero and the upper Isonzo, and the exact division of responsibility between the two commanders is described somewhat differently in the Italian official history and in specialist studies. On the Austrian side Boroević was the real brain of the defence: he concentrated his limited strength on the already fortified lines of the Carso and the Barcis plateau, preferred yielding ground locally to allowing the Italians to cut the railway from Gorizia to Vienna, and reinforced the trenches with howitzers and engineer stores. The Imperial chief of the staff, Rudolf von Waldstätten, still directed the bulk of the army towards the Serbian front, which is why the Isonzo sector received comparatively few reinforcements, and the emperor Franz Joseph I formally approved the defensive posture adopted by the army group. The 3rd and 6th Divisions of the Italian Navy enforced the blockade of Trieste by sea, and the engineers of both sides worked on the forward positions around the clock; the machine gun on which the card focuses was the product of a joint commission of army officers and Fiat engineers, and the Fiat-designed armoured cars were trialled on the Carso in the same months, carrying a Revelli on their turrets.
kits: 卡面上的菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914機槍是此役義軍步兵火力的骨幹。它是義大利第一種大量裝備的自動機槍，水冷式槍身空槍重約九公斤，連水與三腳架約十六公斤，彈藥口徑為6.5毫米，使用卡爾卡諾M91步槍彈，以布製彈鏈供彈，每條約百發，理論射速每分鐘四百五十至五百發，有效射程約五百米、最大射程可達兩千米，操作需射手、裝填手與數名搬彈手。配備上，每個步兵營設一挺組成的機槍連，每連六挺，分屬各步兵連的機槍班，營另配步兵砲兵連與工兵連；本役義軍投入十九個師，按每營六挺推算，配發數量在三百挺以上，全部集中在六十公里左右的一條前線上。該槍亦裝於義大利自行試製的裝甲車、前沿固定機槍巢，以及少量由卡車牽引的機槍架上。同期義軍步兵主力是6.5毫米卡爾卡諾M91步槍，配37毫米與47毫米戰壕迫擊砲、65毫米與75毫米野戰砲、120毫米榴彈砲以及制式手榴彈，阿爾卑斯山地部隊以騾馬馱載補給。奧軍火力核心是8毫米施瓦茨洛塞M.07/12重機槍，另有7.5毫米野戰砲與榴彈砲、10.5毫米M.04曲射砲、15毫米重砲、30.5毫米臼砲，並配可移動的鋼制衝鋒盾與手榴彈。此役尚未出現化學戰裝備。
kitsEn: The Fiat Revelli Mod. 1914 machine gun shown on the card was the backbone of the Italian infantry's firepower in this campaign. It was the first automatic machine gun to be produced in quantity for the Italian army: a water-cooled weapon weighing about nine kilograms empty and roughly sixteen kilograms with its water and tripod, it fired the 6.5mm Carcano M91 cartridge from a woven ammunition belt of about a hundred rounds, worked at a theoretical rate of four hundred and fifty to five hundred rounds a minute, and had an effective range of about five hundred metres with a maximum of two thousand. In the order of battle every infantry battalion carried a machine gun company of six guns, distributed as the machine gun section of each infantry company, and a battalion also had its infantry artillery company and engineer company. With nineteen divisions committed and six guns to a battalion, the number of these weapons on the line exceeded three hundred, all of them concentrated on a front of some sixty kilometres. The same gun was also mounted on the armoured cars then being trialled in Italy, in fixed machine gun nests in the forward line, and on a small number of truck-drawn carriages. The infantry's principal small arm was the 6.5mm Carcano M91 rifle, supported by 37mm and 47mm trench mortars, 65mm and 75mm field guns, 120mm howitzers and standard issue hand grenades, while the Alpine units carried their supplies on pack mules. The core of the Austrian firepower was the 8mm Schwarzlose M.07/12 heavy machine gun, with 7.5mm field guns and howitzers, the 10.5cm M.04 howitzer, 15cm heavy guns, 30.5cm mortars, and mobile steel storm shields for close combat. No chemical warfare equipment appeared in this battle.
tactics: 義軍的戰術可以概括為重砲加機槍掩護下的正面線性攻擊。第二、第三集團軍先以全線炮擊建立火力準備，通常只持續數十分鐘，隨即步兵以營縱隊、連橫隊的密集隊形在機槍與手榴彈掩護下前進；工兵在前面用爆破器材處理石壘與鐵絲網，但義大利工程器材不足，爆破成功率低，突擊常在堡壘前被壓住。機槍的用法也偏被動，多集中在營支撐點或沿交通線配置，很少像後來的步兵班那樣以機槍伴隨突擊隊前出至敵陣前百米之內。奧軍的防禦則充分利用石灰岩台地的地形：正面以施瓦茨洛塞重機槍構成交叉火力，機槍巢前沿土壘與岩堆偽裝，突擊兵攜帶鋼制衝鋒盾在近距離逐段躍進；後方縱深塹壕網與堡壘互相支援，公路由卡爾索台地經戈里齊亞通往維也納，供應與撤退都依賴這條幹線。三個攻擊方向的目標各異：左路奪取托爾明諾與蒙內羅山以切斷戈里齊亞至維也納的鐵路；中路主攻戈里齊亞橋頭堡；右路在卡爾索方向推進以切斷沿海鐵路。義軍在突破不成之後，前進速度取決於棧道修築的快慢，戰線始終膠著在台地南緣。
tacticsEn: The Italian method of fighting can be summed up as a linear frontal attack under cover of artillery and machine gun fire. The 2nd and 3rd Armies first opened with a bombardment along the whole front; the preparation was short, rarely more than a few dozen minutes, and the infantry then advanced in dense formation, battalion columns and company lines, covered by machine guns and hand grenades. Engineers went forward with blasting equipment to deal with the stone blockhouses and wire, but the Italian engineering stores were short and the breaches were seldom successful, so the assault usually stalled in front of the works. The use of the machine gun was largely passive: the guns were grouped at battalion support points or along the lines of communication, and they rarely advanced with the assault troops to within a hundred metres of the enemy trenches in the way infantry platoon machine guns did later. The Austrian defence exploited the limestone plateau: the front was covered by the interlocking fire of Schwarzlose machine guns, the gun nests were disguised with earth banks and rock piles, and the storm troops advanced by short rushes behind their steel shields. Behind the first line a network of trenches and blockhouses supported one another, and the road running from the Carso through Gorizia towards Vienna was the artery along which supply and withdrawal depended. The three axes of attack had different aims: the left was to seize Tolmino and Mount Monte Nero and cut the Gorizia-Vienna railway, the centre made the main effort against the Gorizia bridgehead, and the right was to advance over the Carso to sever the coastal line. Since the rate of advance was governed by the speed with which the mule tracks could be built, the line remained welded to the southern lip of the plateau.
data: 此役自一九一五年六月二十三日打到七月七日，前後十五日。義軍投入十九個師、約二十萬人，奧軍應戰十三個師、約十萬人，正面約六十公里，是少數義軍兵力佔優而仍攻不下來的戰役。砲兵密度是義軍唯一的絕對優勢：戈里齊亞正面配置的野戰砲與榴彈砲超過一千一百門，數目上居歐洲各戰線之首，首日消耗的炮彈以百萬發計，對後勤的壓力遠超作戰本身帶來的壓力。火砲射速與精度不足，炮彈消耗的速率甚至超過補給速度，許多砲位在開火數日後即因缺彈而停火。傷亡方面，義軍在整個戰役中的陣亡、受傷與失聯合計常被估計為一萬人上下，奧軍損失約為其一半至相若，雙方數字在官方戰史與私人回憶錄之間分歧頗大，不宜視為精確值。配發的菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914機槍按每營六挺計，本役前線同時運作的三百餘挺，是義大利陸軍第一次把自動機槍的射速與持續性壓到奧軍塹壕頭上。
dataEn: The campaign ran from 23 June to 7 July 1915, fifteen days in all. Italy committed nineteen divisions and about two hundred thousand men against thirteen divisions and roughly one hundred thousand Austro-Hungarians along a front of some sixty kilometres, one of the few battles in which the Italians had the advantage of numbers and still failed to carry the day. The density of artillery was their only absolute superiority: on the Gorizia front more than eleven hundred field guns and howitzers were deployed, a number unmatched on any front in Europe, and the shells fired on the first day alone ran into millions of rounds, a strain on logistics far greater than the strain the fighting itself imposed. The rate and accuracy of the fire were poor, the consumption of shells outran the supply, and many batteries fell silent after a few days for want of ammunition. On casualties, the Italian dead, wounded and missing over the whole action are commonly estimated at around ten thousand, with the Austrian loss put at between half that figure and a comparable number; the two sides' official histories and private memoirs differ considerably, and the figures should not be read as exact. The Fiat Revelli Mod. 1914 machine guns, at six to a battalion, meant that more than three hundred of them were firing at once along this line: the first time the Italian army had pressed the rate of fire and the sustained delivery of an automatic weapon against the Austrian trenches.
cause: 義大利在一九一四年八月開戰時宣稱中立，卻從未真正中立：一九一五年四月二十六日的倫敦密約把義大利與英、法、俄的協約國綁在一起，交換條件是戰後在奧匈割讓的未劃定領域內取得明確而確定的利益。五月二十三日，義大利王國正式向奧匈帝國宣戰。宣戰的歷史理由可追溯到十九世紀的幾次衝突：一八五九年法普法戰爭中奧地利被逐出倫巴第一八六六年普丹戰爭後威尼斯與弗留利歸屬奧地利；此外一八九〇年代俾斯麥的外交轉向讓義大利自認在同盟體系中受到冷落，擔心德奧終將並肩作戰。實際的引爆點是特倫托的歸屬問題，以及義大利在戰爭初期的見風轉舵形象傷害了本國的民族主義。戰術層面上，卡多爾納在一九一五年春推翻原本的三重進攻計劃，改為沿伊松佐河的三段式正面攻勢，理由是奧軍主力陷於塞爾維亞戰線，防守薄弱的東翼有機可乘。
causeEn: Italy declared neutrality when the war broke out in August 1914 but was never truly neutral: the Treaty of London of 26 April 1915 bound the Kingdom to the Entente in return for clear and definite interests in the territories Austria-Hungary would cede but had not yet specified. On 23 May the Italian kingdom formally declared war on Austria-Hungary. The historical reasons ran back through the conflicts of the nineteenth century: Austria was driven out of Lombardy by the French and Prussian war of 1859, and Venice and Friuli remained Austrian after the Austro-Prussian war of 1866, while Bismarck's diplomatic reversal of the 1890s left Italy feeling sidelined within the alliance system and apprehensive of Germany and Austria marching side by side. The immediate flashpoint was the question of Trieste, and the damage done to Italy's standing by its war of manoeuvre at the outbreak of the conflict. On the tactical level Cadorna abandoned his original plan of a three-pronged strategy in the spring of 1915 and adopted instead a frontal offensive along the Isonzo, reasoning that the bulk of the Austrian army was tied down in Serbia and that the thinly held eastern flank offered an opportunity.
impact: 第一次伊松佐河之役的直接後果是攻勢失敗，但它的方法卻被保留並重複了十一次：一九一五年七月至一九一七年十月，義軍沿同一條河、同一片台地反覆發動攻勢，總計損失以三十萬人計，成為第一次世界大戰中延續最久的單一戰役系列，義大利與奧匈雙方都在此耗盡了血本。戰役把義大利陸軍的戰術思維鎖定在砲火準備加密集步兵的模式上，機槍的運用長期停留在營級支撐而非班級伴隨，直到一九一八年改革後才真正成為步兵班火力的核心；菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914在實戰中暴露的可靠性問題，例如供彈卡殼與機件易污，促成了一九一五年改進型與一九一八年簡化型的出現，而後者的機構延續到義大利陸軍的後期裝備之中。從更長的視角看，伊松佐河消耗了奧匈的預備隊與物資，使帝國在一九一七年無法再同時支應巴爾幹與義大利兩個方向，最終以卡波雷托的崩潰與一九一八年夏季的總崩潰收場。和平條約中意大利真正得到的，正是1915年倫敦密約所指向的領域：南蒂羅爾、的里雅斯特與伊斯特拉。紀念方面，一九三五年的雷迪普利亞烈士陵園落成，所收的兩萬餘具遺骸中相當一部分來自最初這幾次攻勢。
impactEn: The immediate outcome of the First Battle of the Isonzo was failure, but its method was kept and repeated eleven times more: from July 1915 to October 1917 the Italians attacked along the same river and over the same plateau, losing in the process something like three hundred thousand men, and the result was the longest series of battles in a single campaign of the First World War, with both Italy and Austria-Hungary bleeding out on it. The battle locked the Italian army's thinking into the pattern of bombardment plus dense infantry, and the machine gun long remained a battalion support weapon rather than a companion of the platoon, until the reform of 1918 finally placed it at the centre of infantry section firepower; the reliability problems the Fiat Revelli Mod. 1914 exposed under fire, its feed and its vulnerability to fouling, produced the improved model of 1915 and the simplified model of 1918, and the mechanism of the latter continued in Italian service for years afterwards. Seen in the longer view, the Isonzo consumed Austria-Hungary's reserves and matériel, leaving the empire unable to supply the Balkan and Italian fronts at the same time in 1917, and that inability ended in the collapse at Caporetto and in the general breakdown of the summer of 1918. The territories Italy actually received under the peace settlement were the ones the Treaty of London of 1915 had pointed to: South Tyrol, Trieste and Istria. In the realm of commemoration, the Redipuglia memorial was inaugurated in 1935, and a good part of the more than twenty thousand remains it holds came from these first assaults.
result: 七月七日，義軍在戈里齊亞橋頭堡、蒙內羅山與卡爾索三個方向同時停止攻擊，奧軍守住了伊松佐河東岸全部陣地。戰果上沒有任何一座關鍵城市被義軍奪取：戈里齊亞仍在奧軍手中，亞得里亞海的封鎖被解除，通往特倫托的道路依舊暢通；奧軍的損失雖小於對手，仍在巴因西扎與卡爾索前沿留下了無法填補的缺口。對義大利而言，此役的直接收穫是把連續攻勢確立為陸軍的既定方針：同年七月十八日即發動第二次伊松佐河之役，砲兵增加到一千二百門，仍以失敗告終，其後再接第三次、第四次，直到第十一次。對菲亞特·雷維利Mod.1914而言，這十五天是它第一次大規模暴露在野戰條件下：它證明了水冷重機槍可以提供足以壓制塹壕的火力，但也顯示出其供彈機構在長時間射擊下容易失效，重量又不利於山地機動作戰。這門機槍最終的位置，是在1918年10月的總攻中隨義大利步兵一起站上了伊松佐河畔的陣地。
resultEn: On 7 July the Italians called off the attack simultaneously on the Gorizia bridgehead, on Mount Monte Nero and on the Carso, and the Austro-Hungarians held every position on the eastern bank of the Isonzo. In material terms nothing was won: Gorizia remained in Austrian hands, the blockade of the Adriatic was lifted, and the road towards Trieste stayed open, while the Austrian losses, smaller than their opponent's, still left gaps on the Barcis and Carso front that could not be filled. For Italy the direct result was that the doctrine of the continuous offensive became the settled policy of the army: the Second Battle of the Isonzo followed on 18 July of the same year with twelve hundred guns in place, and failed in its turn, and it was followed by a third, a fourth and so on up to the eleventh. For the Fiat Revelli Mod. 1914 these fifteen days were the first great exposure of the gun under field conditions: it demonstrated that a water-cooled heavy machine gun could deliver fire sufficient to dominate a trench line, and equally that its feed mechanism failed often under sustained fire and that its weight was a handicap in mountain manoeuvre. The line the weapon took up, in the end, was in the great Italian offensive of October 1918, when infantry and machine guns stood together on the banks of the Isonzo.
